synopsis: North America was included in the research’s search for collision-warning and automatic-braking standards and regulations for earth-moving, mining and construction machines, covering scope, edition, status, and performance and testing requirements [f2036]. If North America or other non-EU markets are the main targets, the skeptic’s review treats the EU Machinery Regulation and Product Liability Directive analysis as background rather than the primary legal context [f11284]. It instead identifies the MSHA, WorkSafe WA and South African Regulation 8.10 material as the primary legal context for those non-EU target markets collectively, without specifying a North America-only allocation [f11285]. Separately, the glossary states that most countries outside North America approve road vehicles against UNECE regulations; that statement concerns on-road vehicles, not the off-road machines targeted by the research [f15390, f2036].

relations.note: Identifies the alternative primary legal context when EU analysis becomes background.
Adds target-market prioritization to the research’s multinational regulatory search.
Names legal material prioritized when non-EU markets are the main targets.
